prompts.name: 不落之冠
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original hero spaceship visual-development painting for a premium science-fiction civilization/survival game, Stellar Echoes. Create one unforgettable, breathtaking HUMAN MIGRATION ARK, concept A "Crown of Dawn". The vessel must feel like an ancient promise carried into the distant future: majestic, sheltering, audacious and desirable to command.
Primary silhouette: a gigantic OPEN crescent of dark sculpted structural arches embracing a slender luminous inhabited keel. The crescent is steeply tilted across the axial hull, split into three staggered architectural crown blades with large clean negative spaces; they are attached to a long tapering axial tail with unmistakable aft propulsion integrated into its end. It is a travelling city-ship, not a circular space station, portal or fighter. Protective basalt-gray shell planes, sweeping ivory ceramic leading edges, sparse warm bronze edges. Inside the protective arches, tiny layered terraces and ribbon-thin amber habitation lights suggest thousands of sleeping lives. One deliberately placed recessed sheltered harbor with a tiny shuttle for scale. Confident broad surfaces, refined transition lines, 70/20/10 hierarchy of large/medium/tiny details. Cool near-black recesses, sunlit pale edges, restrained amber inner light. Heat-control fins read as elegant dark layered feathers behind the main silhouette, not solar panels pasted everywhere.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024; one complete vessel entirely in frame, 75% frame coverage, front/side three-quarter view with the tail visible. Quiet dark blue-gray deep-space background, very sparse stars and subtle diffuse illumination; clear edge separation. Premium painterly industrial concept art with believable material depth, delicate drafting intelligence, great monumental scale. Beauty must come from proportion, voids and form, not explosions or busy nebulae. No labels, typography, logo, diagrams, UI, weapon racks, giant fighter cockpit, blunt shipping-container grids, gothic ornament or existing franchise ship copies. This is a NEW silhouette exploration, unconstrained by any previous ark image. No simulated blueprint claims.

prompts.name: 远行碑
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original hero spaceship visual-development painting for a premium science-fiction civilization/survival game, Stellar Echoes. Create one unforgettable HUMAN MIGRATION ARK, concept B "Pilgrim Monolith": austere, bold, mysterious, something a player would love to approach and eventually call home.
Primary silhouette: a colossal TALL VERTICAL split monolith moving through space, roughly three times taller than its fore-aft depth, like two elegantly tapered opposing blade-like bastions leaning apart around a long central narrow inhabited chasm. The profile has one striking offset shoulder and a short powerful aft tail connecting the towers: deliberately restrained asymmetry, no standard triangular cruiser. Each bastion has a strong broad pale ceramic face over a graphite inner structure. Negative space between the two enormous volumes reveals deeply nested warm city terraces and a suspended central sanctuary keel supported by visibly massive crossbridges. Two small-looking but monumental propulsion apertures are on the aft horizontal tail; minute side-mounted service docks and a single shuttle establish scale and vehicle direction. The ship is a civilization carrier, not a weapon or building floating without engines. Externally minimal, internally intricate. Broad quiet surfaces, select bronze repair inlays, clustered warm habitation light rather than uniform windows, a few sharply folded dark thermal fins at the aft mass. One controlled asymmetry makes it memorable and still engineered.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024; one complete vessel entirely in frame, 75% frame coverage, front/side three-quarter view showing the depth, sheltered chasm and aft tail. Quiet dark blue-gray space background, very sparse stars, no planet stealing attention. Crisp oblique light on large forms, soft warm human-scale interior glow. Premium painterly industrial concept art, dramatic scale, intelligent materials and proportions, no explosions, no nebula spectacle. No labels, typography, logos, UI, diagrams, big fighter cockpit, guns, skulls, stone masonry, religious ornament or franchise ship copies. The form must be wildly distinct from a normal winged cruiser or wheel station. New silhouette exploration; not an engineering blueprint.

prompts.name: 星种
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original hero spaceship visual-development painting for a premium science-fiction civilization/survival game, Stellar Echoes. Create one unforgettable HUMAN MIGRATION ARK, concept C "Stellar Seed": profound, elegant, alive and protective, a civilization sailing through dark space.
Primary silhouette: an elongated tapered SEED enclosed by THREE unequal sweeping protective shell leaves. The main shell is a huge immaculate pearl-ceramic curved vault, a second darker shell sweeps underneath, the third arcs outwards into a graceful narrow stern. Their overlapping open seams form long asymmetric crescent-shaped negative spaces exposing amber-lit internal town terraces, a glimpse of protected cultivation, bridges and the finely layered graphite axial skeleton. These are manufactured, segmented megastructural shells with purposeful connections, not organic flesh, flower petals, literal wings or glass greenhouse domes. One extremely fine offset arc of thermal structures follows the stern and a compact constellation of modest blue-white propulsion apertures marks the trailing end. A sheltered harbor set into the lower seam, with one tiny service shuttle, establishes that this several-kilometre object carries a community. Avoid aggressively pointed destroyer proportions; calm flowing mass with one memorable sweep, restrained pale ceramic, graphite seams and small warm bronze repair accents. Broad clean planes dominate; fine density is concentrated in the openings.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024; one complete ship entirely in frame, 75% frame coverage, front/side three-quarter view with tail visible. Quiet dark blue-gray deep-space background, sparse stars, subtle oblique light and readable silhouette. Premium painterly industrial concept art with sculptural elegance, immense scale and convincing manufactured surfaces. Let the luminous sheltered interior promise a home. Beauty from shape and light, no explosions, huge nebula, fantasy glowing magic core or giant artificial tree. No labels, typography, logos, UI, diagrams, cockpit bubble, weapon batteries or existing franchise ship copies. Completely new silhouette study, not an engineering blueprint.
